headline: WWE Money in the Bank 2026 live results: Updates, grades, analysis for Roman Reigns vs. LA Knight
author: Anthony Sulla-Heffinger

paragraphs.text: One of the most exciting and potentially landscape-changing premium live events on the WWE calendar is here: Money in the Bank. Follow WWE Money in the Bank 2026 live results, match-by-match updates, highlights, grades, start time and more on this page for Saturday's big show from the Smoothie King Center in New Orleans.

Money in the Bank features two ladder matches with a briefcase suspended above the ring. The winner of each match — one men's and one women's — earns a guaranteed championship match at their choosing over the next year. While the titular match got its start at WrestleMania, Saturday's event marks the 17th year in a row Money in the Bank has been its own standalone event.

The Men's Money in the Bank ladder match features two former top champions in CM Punk (a two-time winner of the MITB briefcase) and Kevin Owens, as well as rising stars Bron Breakker, Trick Williams and Je'Von Evans. Penta, who challenged Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship last month, rounds out the six-man field.

On the women's side, Tiffany Stratton is the lone former WWE Women's Champion in the mix, having won her title by cashing in the Money in the Bank briefcase last year. Joining Stratton is a quintet of up-and-coming talent: Roxanne Perez, Lash Legend, Sol Ruca, Lola Vice and Women's United States Champion Jacy Jayne.

Depending on the order of the card, there will be two chances for Money in the Bank match winners to cash in the same night, as both of "WWE Raw's" top championships will be defended. Reigns puts his World Heavyweight Championship at stake against LA Knight, and Women's World Champion Stephanie Vaquer faces Liv Morgan and Becky Lynch in a triple-threat match.
Finally, Oba Femi takes on Bronson Reed, who returned at Sunday Night's Main Event last month to cost Femi in a match against Breakker.
The full WWE Money in the Bank 2026 match card starts at 6 p.m. ET, and streams live on ESPN Unlimited in the U.S. and on Netflix in most international markets:
• World Heavyweight Championship: Roman Reigns (c.) vs. LA Knight
• Women's World Championship: Stephanie Vaquer (c.) vs. Becky Lynch vs. Liv Morgan
• Men's Money in the Bank ladder match: CM Punk vs. Kevin Owens vs. Je'Von Evans vs. Penta vs. Trick Williams vs. Bron Breakker
• Women's Money in the Bank ladder match: Lola Vice vs. Sol Ruca vs. Lash Legend vs. Jacy Jayne vs. Roxanne Perez vs. Tiffany Stratton
